en: Black‑and‑white view of a European small‑town square with cobblestone pavement. At the center stands a fenced obelisk‑style monument bearing round medallions and plaques. Surrounding it are 3–4 story houses with tiled roofs and shuttered windows. Commercial signs in German advertise businesses such as a steam laundry, a hotel or inn, and a textile shop. One man walks across the foreground while another stands by the monument.
